/workspace/notes/layout_aux.md

**Layouts (all offsets proven from asm)**

- `HorzSegment` (24 B): `left_op`@0, `right_op`@8, `left_to_right`@0x10 (bool). Ctor sets `(op, nullptr, true)`. Size proven twice: `allocate` does `n*3<<3`, `construct` does `operator new(0x18,p)`.
- `HorzJoin` (16 B, trivially copyable): `op1`@0, `op2`@8. `construct` memberwise-copies 2 qwords, no ctor call.
- `IntersectNode` (32 B): `pt`@0 (16 B, initialised first), `edge1`@0x10, `edge2`@0x18. `allocate` uses `shl $5`.
- `ReuseableDataContainer64` (0x38 B, polymorphic): `__vptr`@0 (→0x4316a8), `minima_list_`@8, `vertex_lists_`@0x20. vtable has exactly 2 entries (dtor only). Implied `LocalMinima{vertex@0, polytype@8, is_open@0xc}`; `VertexFlags::LocalMin == 8`, `Vertex::flags`@0x20.
- `PolyPath`: `__vptr`@0, `parent_`@8. `PolyPath64`: `childs_`@0x10 (`vector<unique_ptr<PolyPath64>>`). `polygon_`@0x28 is **inferred only** — `AddChild`/`Polygon()`/ctor are not instantiated in this image, so nothing touches it. Vtable slots: +0x00/+0x08 dtors, +0x10 `AddChild(const Path64&)`, +0x18 `Clear()`, +0x20 `Count() const`.
- `PointD` (16 B): `x`@0, `y`@8, **no z**. `Point<long>` conversion uses `cvtsi2sdq`; `Negate()` XORs the sign bit constant at 0x431980.

**Rect64 field order: `left`@0, `top`@8, `right`@0x10, `bottom`@0x18.** Proven by `Rect(l,t,r,b)` register→offset stores and independently by `AsPath()`, which emits `[(left,top),(right,top),(right,bottom),(left,bottom)]` after `reserve(4)`.

Key semantics: `IsEmpty() = bottom<=top || right<=left`; `Contains(rec)` = `rec.left>=left && rec.right<=right && rec.top>=top && rec.bottom<=bottom` (that order); `MidPoint()` = `((left+right)/2, (top+bottom)/2)` using C truncating signed division (`shr 63; add; sar 1`), not `>>1`.

**Sentinel:** `Rect64(bool)` — `true` → all zeros; `false` → `{INT64_MAX, INT64_MAX, INT64_MIN, INT64_MIN}`. Critically `lowest()` tail-calls `min()` = `0x8000000000000000`, so it is **INT64_MIN, not -INT64_MAX**. `InvalidRect()` is identical. Globals: `InvalidRect64`, `InvalidRectD` (=±DBL_MAX), `invalid_rect = Rect64(false)`.

**GetBounds<long>(Paths64)** starts `xmin=ymin=0x7FFF…FF`, `xmax=ymax=0x8000…00` (folded immediates), does four signed compares per point (`xmin>p.x`, `xmax<p.x`, `ymin>p.y`, `ymax<p.y`), and returns `Rect64(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)` → `left=xmin, top=ymin, right=xmax, bottom=ymax`. No early return, no validity check. **Empty input returns the inverted/invalid rect `{MAX,MAX,MIN,MIN}`, not a zeroed rect.** Single-path overload is identical.

**TranslatePaths<long>**: `reserve(paths.size())` + `std::transform`/`back_inserter` with a 16-byte closure `{dx@0, dy@8}`, delegating to `TranslatePath<long>`, which does `Point64(pt.x+dx, pt.y+dy)` with plain wrapping int64 `add` — no saturation, no rounding. Order preserved.

Bonus offsets confirmed en route: `Active{prev_in_ael@0x48, next_in_ael@0x50}`, `sizeof(Active)=0x88`; `EdgesAdjacentInAEL` checks `next_in_ael` first. `OutPt{pt@0,next@0x10,prev@0x18,outrec@0x20,horz@0x28}`. `OutRec{owner@8,front_edge@0x10,pts@0x20,polypath@0x28,splits@0x30,bounds@0x40,path@0x60,is_open@0x78}`. `ClipperBase{actives_@0x28,minima_list_@0x38,intersect_list_@0x90,horz_seg_list_@0xa8,horz_join_list_@0xc0,has_open_paths_@0xe0,reverse_solution_@0xd9,outrec_list_@0xe8}`. `IntersectListSort` = descending y then ascending x. `HorzSegSorter` used with `stable_sort`, and `ConvertHorzSegsToJoins` returns early when `count_if(...) <= 1`.

`/workspace/notes/layout_core.md`

**Vertex (0x28)**: pt 0x00(16) | next 0x10 | prev 0x18 | flags 0x20(u32) | pad 0x24. Size from `operator new[](n*40)` + `add $0x28` stride in `AddPaths_`.

**VertexFlags**: OpenStart=1, OpenEnd=2, LocalMax=4, LocalMin=8. `operator&`/`|` are plain 32-bit and/or. `IsOpenEnd(Vertex)` = `flags & (1|2)`; `IsMaxima` = `flags & 4`; `AddLocMin` guards/sets bit 8.

**Active (0x88)**: bot 0x00 | top 0x10 | curr_x 0x20(i64) | dx 0x28(f64) | wind_dx 0x30(i32) | wind_cnt 0x34 | wind_cnt2 0x38 | pad 0x3c | outrec 0x40 | prev_in_ael 0x48 | next_in_ael 0x50 | prev_in_sel 0x58 | next_in_sel 0x60 | jump 0x68 | vertex_top 0x70 | local_min 0x78 | is_left_bound 0x80(bool) | join_with 0x84(u32). Ctor: all zero **except wind_dx = 1**. Size from `operator delete(p,0x88)`.

**LocalMinima (0x10)**: vertex 0x00 | polytype 0x08(u32) | is_open 0x0c(bool).

**OutPt (0x30)**: pt 0x00 | next 0x10 | prev 0x18 | outrec 0x20 | horz 0x28 (nulled in ctor, **never touched elsewhere** — dead in this build). Ctor ends `next = prev = this`.

**OutRec (0x80)**: idx 0x00(size_t) | owner 0x08 | front_edge 0x10 | back_edge 0x18 | pts 0x20 | polypath 0x28 | splits 0x30 (`vector<OutRec*>*`, lazily `new`'d 0x18 bytes) | recursive_split 0x38 | bounds 0x40(Rect64) | path 0x60(vector<Point64>) | is_open 0x78. Ctor sets `bounds = Rect64(true)` = all zeros.

**ClipperBase (0x100, polymorphic)**: vptr 0x00 | cliptype_ 0x08 | fillrule_ 0x0c | fillpos=2 0x10 | bot_y_ 0x18 | minima_list_sorted_ 0x20 | using_polytree_ 0x21 | actives_ 0x28 | sel_ 0x30 | minima_list_ 0x38 | loc_min_iter_ 0x50 | vertex_lists_ 0x58 | scanline_list_ 0x70 (priority_queue<i64,less> = **max-heap**, 0x20 bytes) | intersect_nodes_ 0x90 | horz_seg_list_ 0xa8 | horz_join_list_ 0xc0 | preserve_collinear_=**true** 0xd8 | reverse_solution_=false 0xd9 | error_code_ 0xdc (written once, never read) | has_open_paths_ 0xe0 | succeeded_=**true** 0xe1 | outrec_list_ 0xe8.

**Clipper64 (0x100)**: adds no members; ctor = ClipperBase ctor then vptr ← 0x4312f0.

Enums: PathType Subject=0/Clip=1; ClipType 0..4 (jump table at 0x431538); FillRule EvenOdd0/NonZero1/Positive2/Negative3; JoinWith NoJoin0/Left1/Right2.

Also mapped: IntersectNode 0x20 {pt, edge1 0x10, edge2 0x18}, HorzSegment 0x18 {left_op, right_op 0x08, left_to_right 0x10 init **true**}, HorzJoin 0x10, Rect64 {left,top,right,bottom}. Rounding note: `TopX` = `bot.x + (int64)nearbyint(dx*(y-bot.y))` via `call nearbyint@plt` then `cvttsd2si`, with two early-outs (`y==top.y || top.x==bot.x` → `top.x`; `y==bot.y` → `bot.x`).
